title: The palette box border follows the chrome font while its rule follows the palette font
body:
`Scene::line_width` in `draw.rs` is `(cell_width / 8).max(1)` from the font the scene was built with. `Paint::scene` in `compositor.rs` sets the rounded box shader's `border_width` from `self.font.cell_width / 8.0`, the chrome font, for every `Shape::Rounded`. The palette's scene is built from `menu_font`, so its rule line and its box border come out at different widths once the two font sizes differ.

## Proposal

`Scene::rounded` stores the width in `Shape::Rounded` and `Paint::scene` reads it from there. `Paint` then no longer needs `font` for this.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/913b1d2c
notes.text: The `border_width` uniform this issue names is now set in `Paint::scene` in `draw.rs`. Commit 141646e moved `Paint` there from the compositor.
